title: Generalist (Sales)
description: Turn new conversations into opportunities. Build a sales pipeline through prospecting, customer conversations and consistent follow-ups.
details: Prospect for potential customers, qualify leads, understand customer needs and support sales conversations. Maintain accurate CRM records, coordinate next steps and follow up consistently to move opportunities forward. Track pipeline activity and outcomes, and use what you learn to improve outreach and the customer experience.

title: Generalist (Operations)
description: Keep daily work moving. Coordinate workflows, resolve operational issues and make processes simpler and more reliable.
details: Coordinate day-to-day workflows and follow through on tasks across teams. Identify and resolve operational issues, communicate progress and escalate blockers appropriately. Document repeatable processes, keep records accurate and use practical measures to identify improvements in turnaround time, quality and reliability.

title: AI Marketing
description: Own the entire marketing vertical, from paid ads and organic reach to social media, using AI tools to plan, create and improve campaigns.
details: Take end-to-end ownership of the marketing vertical: plan priorities, execute campaigns and measure results across paid ads, organic reach, social media, content and related marketing channels. Use AI tools for research, content creation and campaign workflows while checking accuracy, brand consistency and output quality. Coordinate the content calendar and channel activity, run measurable experiments, track performance and use insights to improve reach, engagement and conversion. Bring a practical, hands-on approach to building and improving the overall marketing function.

title: Interior Designer
description: Design functional, beautiful spaces end to end — from concept and layouts to materials, execution and final styling for live client projects.
details: Work on live interior design projects from concept to execution. Develop design concepts, mood boards, layouts and 3D visualisations, and present them clearly to clients and the team. Select materials, finishes, furniture and fixtures within project budgets. Coordinate with vendors, contractors and site teams to keep execution true to the design. Visit sites, track progress and resolve on-ground issues during execution. Use design and drafting tools (SketchUp, AutoCAD, 3ds Max or similar) and AI tools to speed up concepts, renders and presentations.

title: AI Engineer
description: We are looking for an AI Engineer to build and integrate practical AI and Generative AI solutions. The role involves working with Python, APIs, LLMs, machine learning models, and AI tools to develop, test, and improve intelligent applications.
details:
- Develop and integrate AI/ML and Generative AI solutions.
- Build AI-powered applications using Python and relevant frameworks.
- Work with LLMs, APIs, prompt engineering, and AI tools.
- Develop and integrate REST APIs and external AI services.
- Experiment with different models and approaches to solve practical problems.
- Build workflows involving LLMs, RAG, agents, or other AI application techniques.
- Test, debug, evaluate, and improve AI systems.
- Work with data preparation, model outputs, and evaluation.
- Collaborate with the team to understand requirements and convert them into working solutions.
- Document implementations, experiments, and results.

Requirements:
- Strong understanding of Python programming.
- Basic understanding of Machine Learning and AI concepts.
- Familiarity with Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
- Understanding of APIs and how to integrate external services.
- Familiarity with prompt engineering and AI development tools.
- Basic understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software development practices.
- Ability to debug problems and approach technical challenges logically.
- Hands-on project experience in AI/ML, Generative AI, or software development is preferred.
- Candidates should be willing to learn new AI technologies and work on practical AI applications.
